description: This Java class is a Spring Boot REST controller named NoteController that exposes CRUD operations for notes, including listing all notes, retrieving a note by ID, creating, updating, and deleting notes. It uses annotations for request mapping, API documentation, and validation.

classes.name: NoteController
classes.description: A REST controller class providing CRUD endpoints for notes, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting notes.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Converts a Note object into a NoteResponse DTO.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all notes.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a note by its ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new note.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing note by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete a note by ID.
